checks.detail: A real Codex turn completed without explicitly invoking RunWield.
The packaged skill reached a Core-hosted Plan review through real Codex MCP calls.
A fresh Codex process restored the pending browser review.
Codex answered the queued browser review question through Core.
Codex submitted completed work through Core's task completion operation.
Host shutdown cancelled the observed CI process before restoration.
Core recovered interrupted validation and reached its Code Review gate.
Core returned its delivered action after browser Code Review approval.
The real Codex MCP handshake matches the executable version.
Native spawn identities prove fresh workers directly fetched instructions and complete candidate-bound diff bytes.
Implementation must stay in Core's checkout; invoking source bytes, branch, HEAD, and protected Git status must remain unchanged.
The fixture expects one cancelled check, one restored check, and one check after the forced repair.
Delivery preserves invoking source and Git state, allowing only the current Plan, .wld/internal/ lifecycle files, and the exact Core .gitignore setup block.
The closed delivered workflow must have a publication receipt and the published verified Work Record.
The published commit must contain the exact marker required by the independent fixture review.
Ordinary transcript sentinels are checked against durable artifacts and Git history.

limitations: Existing-auth ephemeral Codex app-server with explicit packaged skill path and package MCP configuration; installed discovery is qualified separately.
No desktop UI claim. No tested-version entry until full independent review and recovery evidence is qualified.
Full access is restricted by the acceptance instructions to disposable repositories; Core receives no host provider credentials.
